# Section documentation for [STACK-Maxima](../../index.md) /linearalgebra/display

Functions for displaying linear systems as aligned TeX equations.


---


## disp_eqns(eqns,vars)<a id='disp_eqns'></a>

Given a list of equations and a list of variables, produce TeX output that displays them as a system of equations.
Everything will be appropriately vertically aligned with leading ones and zeros removed appropriately.



| Argument name | type | description |
| ------------- | ---- | ----------- |
| eqns | list | A list of linear equations. Constants should be on the right hand side. |
| vars | list | A list of variables in the order that they should appear. |




| Return type | description |
| ----------- | ------------|
| string | TeX output for this system of equations |


---


## format_as_coeff(expr)<a id='format_as_coeff'></a>

Format expressions so that they can be printed as coefficients by wrapping sums
and expressions with unary minus into brackets.


| Argument name | type | description |
| ------------- | ---- | ----------- |
| expr | expression | the coefficient to display. Strings are returned unchanged. |




| Return type | description |
| ----------- | ------------|
| string | the TeX coefficient, parenthesised when needed. |


---


## mat_disp_eqns(A,b,vars)<a id='mat_disp_eqns'></a>

Given a matrix, right-hand side vector, and a list of variables, produce TeX output that displays them as a system of equations.
Everything will be appropriately vertically aligned with leading ones and zeros removed appropriately.



| Argument name | type | description |
| ------------- | ---- | ----------- |
| A | matrix | The coefficient matrix. |
| b | matrix | The right hand side vector. |
| vars | list | A list of variables in the order that they should appear. |




| Return type | description |
| ----------- | ------------|
| string | TeX output for this system of equations |
